hearth.events.kind.trial: a trial at the lord's court
hearth.events.notice.trial: %s will be tried before the court today for %s.
hearth.events.notice.acquitted: The court found %s not guilty of %s.
hearth.events.notice.guilty.fine: The court found %s guilty of %s, and fined them.
hearth.events.notice.guilty.pillory: The court found %s guilty of %s: two hours in the pillory.
hearth.events.notice.guilty.gallows: The court found %s guilty of %s. They hang at dawn.
hearth.events.notice.guilty.cell: The court found %s guilty of %s: three days in the cell.
hearth.events.notice.mercy: The lord showed mercy: %s is spared the rope, and banished.
hearth.events.notice.raid: Raiders struck in the night. They carried off %s sacks of stores and %s bits.
hearth.events.notice.raid_repelled: Raiders came in the night, and were driven off.
hearth.events.notice.fire: A house burnt today. The builders will raise it again.
hearth.events.notice.fire_home: Fire at the %s house. The family are lodged with kin till the builders raise it again.
hearth.events.notice.tax_day: The bailiff rides in from %s today for the lord's tax.
hearth.events.notice.tax: The lord's bailiff took %s bits in tax.
hearth.events.notice.tax_excused: The bailiff came, and found nothing above what the town needs. No tax this time.
hearth.events.notice.pig: The %s family could not pay: their pig was led away.
hearth.events.notice.tax_robbed: The lord's tax was robbed on the road: %s bits lost.
hearth.events.notice.fair_coming: The fair comes in three days: stalls, players, and the archery contest.
hearth.events.notice.fair: Fair day! Stalls from far towns, the stage, and the archery contest.
hearth.events.notice.archery: %s won the archery contest at the fair.
hearth.events.notice.tournament_coming: The lord's tournament is in three days. A melee for all comers.
hearth.events.notice.tournament_day: The lord's tournament today at the lists.
hearth.events.notice.tournament: %s carried the day at the lord's tournament.
hearth.events.notice.topping_out: The roof is on %s. The crew drink to it this evening.
hearth.events.notice.christening: %s will be christened at the chapel.
hearth.events.notice.decree: The crier reads the lord's decree in the square at noon.
hearth.events.answer.quiet: Nothing much. A quiet day, God be thanked.
hearth.events.answer.fair_week: the fair, a week from now
hearth.events.answer.wed_today: %s, today, at %s. Come, everyone's welcome at the feast.
hearth.events.answer.wed_days: %s. The banns are read: at %s, in %3$s days.
hearth.events.answer.gift: That's kind of you. We won't forget it.
hearth.events.answer.short: You haven't the coin for that, friend.
hearth.events.answer.burial: God bless you. %s will have a proper grave and the bell rung.
hearth.events.testify.for_saw: I saw what happened. Speak for %s
hearth.events.testify.against_saw: I saw what happened. Speak against %s
hearth.events.answer.believed: The court hears you. It will weigh what you said.
hearth.events.answer.not_believed: And who are you to say so? The court is not moved.
hearth.events.answer.fine_paid: Paid, then. They'll go home to their children, not to the boards.
hearth.events.answer.let_out: Paid. Unlock him, then. Go on, off with you.
hearth.events.answer.freed: You... you'd do that? Quick, before the watch comes!
hearth.events.answer.mercy: Very well. Let it not be said this house knows no mercy. Banish him.
hearth.events.answer.no_mercy: He killed a man. The law will have its due.
hearth.events.answer.archery: Ten arrows, at the mark. A hit scores the target's own strength. Good luck.
hearth.events.answer.full: The round is full. Try the next one.
hearth.events.archery.won: You won the archery contest! A purse of %s bits.
hearth.events.archery.lost: Your score: %s. The best of the folk shot %s.
hearth.events.melee.enter: Enter the melee for all comers (%s)
hearth.events.answer.melee: Step into the ring when you're ready. Yield at a quarter of your strength, and nobody dies.
hearth.events.melee.enter_first: Enter the melee first (talk to any of the townsfolk).
hearth.events.melee.begin: Round %s! The champion comes at you.
hearth.events.melee.round_won: The champion yields! Rounds: %s won, %s lost.
hearth.events.melee.won: You won the melee! A purse of %s bits, a horse, and the lord's favour.
hearth.events.answer.tax: You'd pay for the %s family? Then their pig stays. They'll not forget this.
hearth.events.answer.crew: A health to you! Drink up, lads, it's on the stranger.
hearth.events.rebuild: Give to the rebuilding of the %s house (%s)
hearth.events.answer.rebuild: That'll buy timber. We'll have them under a roof a day sooner.
hearth.events.wedding.danced: You dance at the wedding feast.
